notes.title: Release, Desktop version
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce a very important update for our Virtual Reality experience!

We have worked hard to make this exciting adventure accessible to everyone, regardless of the presence of a VR device. 

We are excited to present to you the adapted Desktop version of the experience!

The intuitive control experienced in VR has been optimized into commands for the desktop, allowing you to easily control the experience with your keyboard and mouse.

Regards.
